adjudication_scope: close/reopen durability invariant for U1 unrelated-success path

actual_in_handle_equals_reopened_establi.rationale: Persistence occurs at successful apply/commit, not at close. Close releases handle; reopen independently reconstructs via append replay or SQLite load. New predicate asks whether reconstructed snapshot equals post-ack in-handle snapshot.

oracle_independence_persist_reopen_oracl.rationale: post_apply_oracle_compare (expected vs in-handle), persist_reopen_oracle_compare (expected vs reopen), and persist_reopen_authority_unchanged (in-handle vs reopen) are three independent checks. Wrong persisted state can pass durability equality while failing oracle.

semantically_different_states_false_pass.rationale: CurrentContractState PartialEq is derived over full struct fields. Opposite risk: oracle can pass while PartialEq fails on non-canonical rebuild fields (e.g. SQLite display_name); that motivated the 1510e3d fix.

append_sqlite_observation_equivalence.rationale: Both paths: scoped apply → in-handle snapshot → close → open_read_only → reopen snapshot → same record() formula. Physical reconstruct differs but predicate semantics identical.

candidate_authority_semantics_changed.rationale: Evidence observation binding only. Stale rejection persist_reopen_authority_unchanged unchanged (authority_before == authority_after_reopen).

storage_recovery_behavior_changed.rationale: No changes to append/SQLite persist, replay, checkpoint, writer lease, or reconstruct paths at 1510e3d.

caveats: persist_reopen_authority_unchanged is full-struct PartialEq of candidate snapshots, not oracle semantic proof by itself
SQLite reconstruct may blank project_scope.display_name; oracle covers semantic equivalence where PartialEq would not
close is not a persist barrier; apply/commit is
claim strength remains LogicalStateTransition for U1 persist+reopen, not FilesystemDurability

claim_boundary.may_claim: U1 close/reopen preserved the committed in-handle authority snapshot on both Append 01B-3 and SQLite 01C-SQLITE-3
claim_boundary.may_not_claim: FilesystemDurability, oracle-semantic proof via persist_reopen_authority_unchanged alone, candidate implementation change at 1510e3d

bottom_line: 1510e3d correctly rebinds U1 persist_reopen_authority_unchanged to in-handle vs independently reopened committed state. Semantic correctness remains on persist_reopen_oracle_compare. No candidate or recovery path changed. R2-01 may close; proceed to R2-02.
